title: Peruvian Cheese Pollo A La Brasa
description: A kid-friendly Peruvian dish featuring white masarepa and a cheese-pull, made with flambe and vegetarian-friendly ingredients, in the form of pollo a la brasa.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the white masarepa, salt, black pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder.
Gradually add in the vegetable oil and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into balls.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a slice of fatty cheese in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Place the sealed dough pockets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the melted mozzarella cheese over the top of each pocket.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and flambe with a torch or under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
